name: Rod of Alertness
summary: A rod that sharpens your senses, casts detection spells, and projects a protective aura.

stats.effect:
This rod has the following properties.

***Alertness.*** While holding the rod, you have {ref:glossary/advantage} on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on {ref:glossary/initiative} rolls.

***Spells.*** While holding the rod, you can cast the following spells from it:
- *{ref:spell/detect-evil-and-good}*
- *{ref:spell/detect-magic}*
- *{ref:spell/detect-poison-and-disease}*
- *{ref:spell/see-invisibility}*

***Protective Aura.*** As a {ref:glossary/magic} action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground, whereupon the rod's head sheds {ref:glossary/bright-light} in a 60-foot radius and {ref:glossary/dim-light} for an additional 60 feet. While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to {ref:glossary/armor-class} and saving throws and can sense the location of any {ref:condition/invisible} creature that is also in the Bright Light.

The rod's head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes or when a creature takes a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
